summary: PR guard evaluation runs from a read-only base worktree outside the head checkout, starting at the first executable after the workflow; head is only an explicit target, and every gate declares a trust contract stating its real guarantee scope.
rationale: Without base execution a PR can change the entry wrapper, engine, protection list or policy that judge it. Review chapters 10-13 extended the base boundary to the whole call chain and replaced a binary gate classification with per-gate trust contracts, including the mixed-trust Architecture Conformance gate. Guarantees are limited by section 11.4 because workflow definitions and Git approval settings remain deferred item O1. Plan 06 sections 11 and 17 D9.
